question.problem: If $\cot x = 1$ for some $x,$ then find the value of $\cot(x+5\pi).$
question.worked_solution:
The period of $y = \cot x$ is $\pi.$ Therefore, for any integer $n,$ we have

$$
\cot{x} = \cot{(x+n\pi)} .
$$

Substituting $n=5$ into the above gives

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cot}⁡x & =\operatorname{cot}⁡(x+5\cdot \pi ) \\  & =\operatorname{cot}⁡(x+5\pi ).\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, if $\cot{x} = 1,$ then $\cot{(x+5\pi)} = 1.$
